svg.text: SYNCHORA — ESP32 WEARABLE DEVICE — FULL CIRCUIT SCHEMATIC
Auto-generated from firmware pin map (config/pins.h) • MCU: ESP32 DevKit
(30-pin — pins not in use are hidden)
WiFi Status LED (D1, blinks while connecting)
Recording LED (D2, on while capturing audio)
Socket Connected LED (D3, solid = WS linked)
INPUT_PULLUP — pressed = LOW, other leg → GND
Hold 5s = trigger SOS, hold 2s while active = cancel
VIN / 5V (unused rail, brought out for reference)
Sends TOKEN on connect, telemetry every 60s
Reconnect: WiFi 5s check / WS auto 3s retry
